scope: Descriptive paired fixed-workload A/B; two integrated->inline rounds and one direct parent->inline round. Cycles and wall are same-host interfered observations, not clean-host performance admission.
statistics: Each side has eight independent process samples. Min/median/max/mean and population CV are computed per side. right_over_left_pct=(right statistic/left statistic-1)*100 for min/median/max/mean; CV change is percentage points. Whole-process counters include startup, compilation and teardown.

interference.reason: Concurrent rustc processes observed during both inline rounds and Parent comparison; high host load.
